svg.title: One row of stitches, one ordered record
svg.desc: Four rows of 24 schematic stitch cells, grouped into four sections of six. Pink counts alternate 3,1,3,1 and 1,3,1,3. Every row totals eight pink and sixteen green. Matrix entries summarize sections, not individual stitches. Rows are shown in record order.
svg.text: A 24-stitch sampler → four section counts per row
A matrix entry counts pink stitches in a six-stitch section; the rest are green.
Schematic symbols, not loop-accurate technique instructions. Row numbers define the record order.
